name: Harriet (Andrews)
sources: The Oregonian (Portland), 22 Jun 1970, obituary of Florence C. Bird (via FamilySearch / GenealogyBank, ark 1:1:Q5Q4-GBJ3)
notes: Named as Harriet Andrews, a daughter, in the Oregonian obituary of Florence C. Bird, 22 Jun 1970. Her birth surname (Whitney or Hinds) and dates are not yet known; she is not in the 1920 Whitney household, so she was born after January 1920 and could be a full sister of Marrion.
